implementation.note: Native Metal A/B client captures show only the flagged effect casts a shadow; swapping only castShadow moves the shadow to the other identical model. Both remain visible with unchanged material alpha.

architecture.note: Existing FxModelEffect owns authored flag; AnimatedModelEffectView passes kDrawNoCastShadow to shared Renderer3D. No alternate shadow solver or consumer-specific material workaround.

native_api.note: FxModelEffect.castShadow defaults true; shared model submit maps false to the established draw flag. Native client model effect path verified with paired flags.

skill.note: Existing owner recipe documents exact authoring route, shared semantics, example and verified backend limits.

studio.note: Actual native Effects Set/Get saved castShadow false, additive model material and display-space additive emitter, with zero warnings. Invalid alpha+display was rejected; fresh MCP process read identical JSON after reopen and disk bytes were unchanged. Existing JSON operation panel, not graph canvas/preview or Undo acceptance.

dependencies.note: Reuses ModelAssetProvider lifetime, ParticleSystem model instances and Renderer3D shadow admission. No new package or graphics dependency.

examples.note: Three ordinary material-effects scenes verified in actual Metal and WebGL captures: shadow switch, weighted/unweighted model addition, linear/display particles. No special demo runtime path. Publication pending.
